title: Exhibit a main-input separator for the rational chart-339 helper quotient
body:
With all three proposed helper inputs zero, setting native main input 54 to four gives the two retained arrivals zero and arrival 92032 equal to one. Removing the last arrival changes main output 40 by −7. No recoding of the three immediate readers using just the two retained arrivals can repair it. A separate full-cost calculation for the specified invalid quotient loses one rank-nine productive helper against one grade-two paid saving.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. Extends #7877 with an arbitrary-native-input main-axis separator, while isolated main pulse reachability in the closed caller is open. python3 -I -B verify.py cold-replays all 1,289 input columns, terminal adjoints, helper identity and altered receipt/source controls. OpenAI Codex assisted; retained contributors credited.

## Open next questions

Allow funded predecessor compensation or change the reader input contract and validate the closed application.
